text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I’d be glad to support your medical conference admin work. I understand you need someone who can research medical literature and accurately enter author names and email addresses into an Excel spreadsheet. I have 5 years of experience working with data, spreadsheets, and structured information, and I’m comfortable handling careful research and clean data entry with attention to detail.

My background includes SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard work, data cleaning, and data visualization. While my past projects were in different industries, they show the same strengths needed for this role: accuracy, organization, and the ability to manage information reliably.

For example, on the Sales KPI dashboard project for Marlowe Furniture, I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model that replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports. That work helped reduce monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. This project reflects my ability to organize large amounts of information into a clean, usable format.

On the Parent survey analysis project for Riverbend Education Fund, I cleaned and weighted a 4,200-response survey and wrote the findings for the board. That experience strengthened my ability to work carefully with large datasets, verify information, and present data in a clear and usable way.

For your project, I would approach the task by researching the requested medical publications, capturing the author contact details accurately, and keeping the spreadsheet organized and consistent. I’m comfortable following instructions closely and handling repetitive work with care, which is important for research and data entry tasks like this one.

If you’re looking for someone who is dependable, detail-oriented, and efficient with spreadsheet-based admin work, I’d be happy to help. I can contribute solid research support and accurate Excel entry so you can move through the conference preparation process with less stress.
